PREMIUM SOUND SYSTEM, COMFORT PACK, SMOKED TAILLIGHTS, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2020 Aston Martin Vantage embodies the perfect fusion of athleticism, luxury, and design––an uncompromising sports car born from the track and refined for the open road. As the most driver-focused model in Aston Martin's lineup, the Vantage delivers a raw yet refined experience that showcases the brand's racing heritage and handcrafted excellence. Under the hood lies a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, sourced from AMG but tuned exclusively by Aston Martin engineers to deliver 503 horsepower and 505 lb-ft of torque. Power is routed to the rear wheels through a ZF 8-speed automatic transmission, launching the Vantage from 0-60 mph in just 3.5 seconds and on to a top speed of 195 mph. The sound is intoxicating––an aggressive, crackling exhaust note that turns heads on every drive. The Vantage's chassis is pure Aston Martin. Its adaptive damping system, electronic rear differential, and perfect 50:50 weight distribution create handling that's razor-sharp yet confidence-inspiring. Visually, the design is unmistakable: a long clamshell hood, wide stance, and Diavolo Red paint give it presence from every angle. Inside, the Vantage combines craftsmanship with contemporary performance design. The driver-centric cockpit features plush leather with contrast stitching, an Alcantara headliner and digital instrumentation, all wrapped in a cabin that feels intimate and bespoke. Equal parts grand tourer and pure driver's machine, the Aston Martin Vantage delivers emotion with every turn of the wheel. From its handcrafted details to its visceral performance, the Vantage captures the essence of what makes Aston Martin special: substance, sophistication, and soul.

description: 2013 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 3LZ // 60th Anniversary Design Package // Z06 Carbon Fiber Package / / 9,000 Miles // Collector Grade // Sold by AutoPark Dallas AutoPark Dallas is proud to present what we genuinely believe is one of the finest C6 Corvette Z06s ever built. Not one of the nicest we've owned... One of the nicest... Period . This spectacular 2013 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 3LZ, finished in Arctic White over the exclusive Diamond Blue 60th Anniversary Interior, shows only approximately 9,324 original miles and is equipped with virtually every desirable factory option available. Guys... If your dream is to own one of the most special Corvettes ever produced... Here it is. Yesterday... I personally got in this car and drove it around the block. Within about thirty seconds... I knew exactly what we had. This car doesn't just drive like a new Corvette. It feels new. It smells new. It feels like it rolled off the assembly line yesterday. The steering. The clutch. The shifter. The leather. Everything reminds you that this car has lived an incredibly pampered life. You can immediately tell this wasn't somebody's daily driver. This was somebody's baby. A car that spent its life tucked away in a climate-controlled garage, brought out occasionally, driven just enough to keep everything exercised, serviced meticulously, and then put right back under its cover. Let's talk about the elephant in the room... The spec. Because this isn't just another Z06. It's the last production year of the C6 Z06. It's a 3LZ. It's a 60th Anniversary Design Package car. It has the 60th Anniversary Stripe Package. It has the Z06 Carbon Fiber Package. It has Magnetic Selective Ride Control. It has the Carbon Fiber Raised Center Hood. It has the Black Lightweight Cup Wheels. And it's wrapped in what is arguably one of the most beautiful interiors Chevrolet has ever offered... Diamond Blue. Let's say it louder for the people in the back... THIS IS THE ONE YOU WANT. The original MSRP was right at $100,000. For a naturally aspirated C6 Z06. Think about that. When you start checking every one of these option boxes... The price climbs fast. And today... Trying to duplicate this car would be nearly impossible. Then let's talk about the condition. We had to work incredibly hard to convince the previous owner to let this car go. Honestly... He fought with himself over selling it. And after seeing it... We completely understand why. This isn't just another Corvette. This is one of those cars that belongs in a museum. Or in one of the finest private collections in the country. As many of you know... We've bought and sold an unbelievable number of C6 Z06s over the years. We know these cars. We live this market. And we're telling you... You simply don't find them like this anymore. Some people will look at the price and compare it to a $50,000 Z06. That's like comparing a random Rolex to a rare vintage Daytona. They're not the same product. The 2025 Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray 2LZ represents a significant achievement in automotive performance, combining hybrid electric technology with traditional high-performance engineering in a way that delivers real-world capability and efficiency. This black example with 9,876 miles has been meticulously maintained and offers the next owner an opportunity to experience a genuinely innovative sports car that doesn't compromise on practicality or driving engagement.

- GT2 bucket seats with heated and ventilated capability
- Transparent removable roof panel with storage pouch
- ZER Performance Package with high-performance tires
- Front lift adjustable height with memory
- Bose Performance Series sound system with 14 speakers

- HD front and rear vision cameras with rear cross traffic alert
- Wireless charging for devices
- Heated steering wheel
- Bright red-painted calipers
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system with navigation

- 20" x 10" front and 21" x 13" rear gloss black forged aluminum wheels

The powertrain in this Corvette E-Ray delivers dual-motor hybrid performance with the capability to operate as both a conventional sports car and an electric vehicle. The 6.2L V8 engine pairs with electric motors to provide distinctive acceleration and handling characteristics, while achieving 16 MPGe in the city and 24 MPGe on the highway. The eight-speed dual-clutch transmission engages smoothly across all driving conditions, and the all-wheel-drive system ensures confident traction whether you're navigating spirited canyon roads or daily commutes.

The E-Ray 2LZ trim level reflects thoughtful specification choices that enhance both the driving experience and daily usability. The GT2 bucket seats offer substantial support and can be heated or ventilated according to your preference. The transparent removable roof panel allows natural light into the cabin while maintaining the coupe's structural integrity and aerodynamic profile. The front lift adjustable height with memory function proves particularly useful when approaching steep driveways or parking areas, automatically lowering the car to its normal ride height at a preset speed.

The interior environment reflects premium material choices and practical design. Leather seating surfaces with perforated inserts maintain comfort during extended driving, while the heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control adapt to your preferences. The Bose Performance Series sound system with 14 speakers delivers clear audio whether you're enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio or streaming through Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium with navigation capability. Wireless device charging eliminates cable clutter, and the performance data and video recorder captures your drives for review and documentation.

The E-Ray 2LZ presents a compelling ownership proposition for someone seeking a sports car that balances performance with efficiency, capability with convenience. The black exterior finish, combined with the gloss black forged aluminum wheels and red-painted calipers, creates distinctive visual presence while the performance package ensures driving dynamics match the aesthetic promise. We invite you to schedule a time to examine this vehicle in detail and to discuss how it meets your automotive needs.

2007 Porsche 911 Carrera S Coupe: Atlas Grey, Sport Exhaust, Turbo Wheels, and a 997.1 Worth Paying Attention To

This 2007 Porsche 911 Carrera S Coupe is exactly the kind of 997.1 that more Porsche buyers should be paying attention to.

Finished in Atlas Grey Metallic over Black Leather Seats, this Carrera S has the clean, understated, driver-focused look that makes the 997 generation so good. It is not trying too hard. It is not overstyled. It is a properly proportioned, naturally aspirated 911 with the right options, the right stance, and the kind of mechanical feel that newer cars have slowly moved away from.

With an original MSRP of $93,735, this Carrera S was ordered with a great specification including Sport Exhaust System, 19-inch Turbo wheels, 5mm wheel spacers, BOSE High End Sound, Supple Leather front and rear, Power Seat Package, self-dimming mirrors, and a rear window wiper.

This is a simple, sharp, enthusiast-friendly Carrera S.

Why the 997.1 Carrera S Matters

The 997.1 Carrera S has aged beautifully because it represents one of the best modern 911 formulas.

It still has the classic size.
It still has hydraulic steering feel.
It still feels compact and mechanical.
It still has naturally aspirated power.
It still looks like a proper 911.

The 997 brought Porsche back to the classic round-headlight look and gave the 911 a cleaner, more timeless design after the 996 generation. Today, the 997.1 has become one of the most attractive ways to own a modern classic 911 because it gives you enough refinement to use regularly, but enough analog feel to make every drive feel special.

The Carrera S is the one people tend to want because it adds more performance, stronger presence, and the right enthusiast character without stepping into Turbo or GT3 territory.

What Makes This Car Special

This car has the right look and the right options.

Atlas Grey Metallic is one of those Porsche colors that works especially well on the 997 body. It is darker and more interesting than silver, more subtle than black, and it gives the car a mature, technical, expensive look. Paired with the 19-inch Turbo wheels, 5mm wheel spacers, and Sport Exhaust, the whole car has the right amount of presence.

The Sport Exhaust System is one of the most important options on any naturally aspirated 911. It gives the flat-six the voice it deserves and adds real emotion to the driving experience. A 997.1 Carrera S with Sport Exhaust simply feels more alive.

The 19-inch Turbo wheels and 5mm spacers help the stance. They make the car look planted, wider, and more purposeful without needing aftermarket changes. The Supple Leather front and rear gives the interior a richer feel, while BOSE and the Power Seat Package make it comfortable enough to enjoy often.

It is a clean, tasteful, factory-equipped Carrera S with the options people actually care about.

Stop Overlooking the 997.1

Too many buyers still get scared off by internet talking points around IMS bearings and bore scoring. Those are real topics to understand and inspect for, but they are not reasons to dismiss every 997.1 Carrera S.

By 2006 and later, the M97 engine used a larger, non-serviceable IMS bearing design compared with the earlier serviceable units that dominate most of the online fear. Bore scoring is also not something that should be discussed without context. Climate, warm-up behavior, maintenance, oil change habits, and how the car was driven all matter.

Cars that live in colder climates and are started, immediately loaded up, and driven hard before getting proper temperature are generally the ones buyers worry about most.

This car spent much of its life in Texas, which is a positive part of the story. That does not replace a proper inspection, but it does add helpful context. More importantly, this car has a clean CARFAX accident history, low mileage for the year, and recent Porsche dealer service.

The right way to buy a 997.1 is not to panic.

The right way is to buy the right car, with the right history, the right condition, and the right inspection.

For a 997.1 Carrera S, that kind of recent dealer service helps tell the story of a car that has continued to receive attention rather than being neglected.

Why Someone Should Buy It

This Carrera S is for someone who wants a real 911 experience without chasing the most obvious or overpriced version.

It has the naturally aspirated engine.
It has the classic 997 shape.
It has Sport Exhaust.
It has Turbo wheels.
It has a great stance.

It has the right color.
It has the right feel.

The 997.1 Carrera S is one of the cars buyers may look back on and realize they should have bought sooner. As newer 911s get larger, more complex, and more expensive, these cars continue to make more sense. They are modern enough to enjoy, but old-school enough to feel special.

That is the sweet spot.

The white exterior finish showcases the aggressive styling elements that define this model, including the distinctive carbon-painted ground effects and the commanding rear spoiler that speaks to this vehicle's engineering heritage.

The two-tone GT bucket seats provide exceptional support, with heating and ventilation functions for year-round comfort. The sueded microfiber steering wheel and leather shift knob create a premium tactile experience that enhances every drive.

This model delivers a V8 engine mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission with paddle shift controls, allowing you to manage power delivery with precision. The adaptive suspension system works in concert with four-wheel independent suspension geometry to balance responsive handling with ride quality. Speed-sensing steering and traction control technologies ensure confident cornering and stability in various driving conditions.

The technology integration centers on a Chevrolet MyLink system that includes navigation capability, AM/FM radio with SiriusXM satellite access, and a 9-speaker Bose audio system. The addition of Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps your smartphone integrated seamlessly. A head-up display projects essential information onto the windshield, minimizing distractions while driving.

Safety and convenience features include front and rear parking cameras, electronic stability control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a suite of airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Remote keyless entry and a remote vehicle starter system add practical everyday benefits. The universal home remote control offers additional convenience for garage management.

This Corvette Z06 2LZ stands ready for qualified buyers who appreciate genuine performance machinery with premium appointments and modern technology integration. We invite you to schedule a viewing and experience firsthand the refined character this model delivers.

description: 2018 Porsche 911 Carrera 4S Coupe $136,350 Original MSRP Porsche CPO History Sport Chrono Sport Exhaust 14-Way Sport Seats Premium Package Bose Surround Night Blue Metallic Not all Porsche 911s are created equal. The difference between an average Carrera 4S and one enthusiasts actively search for comes down to how it was ordered, how it was maintained, and how it was cared for. This stunning 2018 Porsche 911 Carrera 4S checks every one of those boxes. Finished in breathtaking Night Blue Metallic over the incredibly elegant Black/Luxor Beige two-tone leather interior , this Porsche carried an astounding original MSRP of $136,350 , placing it among the better-equipped Carrera 4S models built that year. Even more impressive, this car was previously retailed by a Porsche dealer as a Porsche Approved Certified Pre-Owned vehicle on September 17, 2024 , after successfully completing Porsche's comprehensive certification process. That designation is only awarded to vehicles meeting Porsche's extremely strict mechanical and cosmetic standards and is one of the strongest indicators that this 911 has been exceptionally maintained throughout its life. Today it shows just 74,289 miles , remains a three-owner, Clean CARFAX example with excellent dealer service history, and needs absolutely nothing. Prior to delivery we are installing brand-new front performance tires , while the rear tires have already been replaced , eliminating one of the biggest ownership expenses for the next enthusiast. Factory Ordered With Over $24,000 In Premium Options When this Carrera 4S was ordered new, no corners were cut. The original owner selected an impressive list of factory equipment that dramatically improves both the driving experience and long-term desirability. Night Blue Metallic Paint ($720) One of Porsche's most elegant metallic colors, Night Blue Metallic changes dramatically depending on lighting conditions. In direct sunlight it displays rich blue metallic flake, while in lower light it appears almost black. It is considerably more unique than the common black, silver, or white 911s seen on the road and gives the car a sophisticated, timeless appearance. Black / Luxor Beige Two-Tone Full Leather Interior ($4,280) This is one of the most expensive interior upgrades available on the Carrera. Rather than standard black upholstery, Porsche fitted this car with a beautiful two-tone Black and Luxor Beige leather cabin that transforms the interior into something much more luxurious and upscale. The lighter lower cabin creates a far more open, premium environment while maintaining the sporting nature expected from a 911. This option alone cost over $4,200 when new and remains one of the most desirable interior combinations Porsche offered. 14-Way Power Sport Seats ($2,330) One of the best seating options Porsche offers. These seats provide 14 individual power adjustments , including adjustable side bolsters, thigh support, lumbar support, seat height, backrest angle, and memory functions, allowing drivers of virtually any size to find the perfect driving position. Whether you're commuting across town or spending an entire weekend carving through mountain roads, these seats offer outstanding comfort without sacrificing the support expected from a true sports car. Premium Package ($620) The Premium Package enhances the luxury experience with several highly desirable convenience features that elevate everyday ownership. Combined with the upgraded sport seats, it creates a much more refined driving experience while maintaining Porsche's driver-focused cockpit. Electric Glass Slide/Tilt Sunroof ($2,000) A highly sought-after option that floods the cabin with natural light while maintaining the clean coupe profile. Open it on a cool evening and enjoy the unmistakable sound of Porsche's flat-six engine echoing through the cabin. Sport Exhaust System ($2,950) One of the most desirable performance options available. At the touch of a button, Porsche's factory Sport Exhaust transforms the personality of the car. Normal mode remains refined and quiet for everyday driving. Activate Sport Exhaust and the car comes alive with the unmistakable mechanical howl that only a naturally aspirated Porsche flat-six can deliver. This is one of those options owners specifically search for because retrofitting a genuine Porsche Sport Exhaust system can cost many thousands of dollars. Sport Chrono Package ($2,090) Arguably the single most important performance option on any modern Porsche. Sport Chrono completely changes how the Carrera 4S drives. Features include: • Steering-wheel mounted Mode Selector • Sport Response Button • Sharper throttle calibration • Faster PDK shift programming • Revised stability management settings • Dynamic engine mounts • Launch Control • Dashboard-mounted Sport Chrono stopwatch For enthusiasts, Sport Chrono isn't simply an option—it's considered almost mandatory on a properly equipped 911. BOSE Surround Sound System ($1,600) Porsche's premium factory audio system delivers crisp highs, deep bass, and exceptional clarity throughout the cabin. Whether you're listening to your favorite playlist or simply cruising with the windows down, the BOSE system offers a substantial improvement over the standard audio package and remains one of the most desirable comfort upgrades. Seat Ventilation ($840) A must-have feature in Texas and other warm climates. Ventilated front seats circulate cool air through the perforated leather, making summer driving dramatically more comfortable while preserving the premium appearance of the leather interior. Porsche Entry & Drive ($1,100) Porsche's advanced keyless entry system allows you to unlock, start, and drive the vehicle without ever removing the key from your pocket. Small convenience features like this quickly become indispensable in everyday ownership. Lane Change Assist ($850) Using radar-based monitoring, Lane Change Assist watches your blind spots and alerts you to approaching vehicles before changing lanes. It adds an extra level of confidence during highway driving while maintaining Porsche's driver-focused experience. Colored Porsche Crest Wheel Center Caps ($190) A subtle but unmistakable finishing touch. The full-color Porsche crests elevate the appearance of the factory wheels and demonstrate the attention to detail that went into ordering this Carrera. The Legendary Carrera 4S Power comes from Porsche's incredible 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged horizontally opposed six-cylinder , producing 420 horsepower , paired with the phenomenal 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) transmission. The PDK remains one of the fastest and most refined dual-clutch transmissions ever engineered, delivering lightning-fast gear changes while remaining perfectly civilized in daily driving. Power is sent through Porsche's legendary Carrera 4 all-wheel-drive system , providing remarkable traction, increased driver confidence, and exceptional year-round usability without sacrificing the balanced handling characteristics that have made the 911 famous for decades. The sport steering wheel and telescoping adjustment offer personalized comfort, while the leather shift knob and comprehensive gauge cluster keep all performance metrics visible. Climate control comes standard with automatic temperature regulation and front dual-zone capability, ensuring comfort regardless of season.

Modern technology seamlessly integrates into your driving experience through the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system with a touchscreen interface, voice recognition, and Bluetooth hands-free connectivity. OnStar and connected services capability provide security and convenience features, while the premium 10-speaker sound system with SiriusXM radio keeps you entertained during every journey. The backup camera and sight-line monitors enhance safety and visibility in all driving situations.

The chassis features four-wheel independent suspension with magnetic ride control that adapts to road conditions, delivering controlled handling whether navigating city streets or open roads. Velocity yellow-painted calipers stop the vehicle with confidence through four-wheel disc brakes, while electronic stability control and traction management systems work continuously to maintain composure. Speed-sensing power steering provides responsive feedback and precise control.

The genuine Corvette accessories including black custom splash guards, black lug nuts, and composite rocker extensions underscore meticulous attention to detail and style. We welcome you to experience this remarkable sports car firsthand at our showroom.

This 2016 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat brings serious performance capability to your driveway, finished in striking Red with the engineering and presence that commands attention.

- 6.2L V8 Supercharged engine
- 8-Speed Automatic transmission with remote start and steering wheel mounted shift control
- Quick Order Package 26R SRT Hellcat
- Uconnect 8.4 NAV with Navigation System
- Premium Harman/Kardon® audio system with 18 speakers and SiriusXM
- Laguna Performance Seats with SRT Embossed Logo
- Heated and ventilated front seats
- Heated steering wheel
- 20" SRT Low-Gloss Black Forged wheels with Pirelli tires
- Adaptive suspension with four-wheel independent setup
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with High-Intensity Discharge
- Dual-zone automatic climate control
- Speed-sensing steering with front and rear anti-roll bars

The commanding 6.2L supercharged V8 paired with an 8-speed automatic delivers the performance you expect from a SRT Hellcat, achieving 13 MPG city and 22 MPG highway. The transmission includes remote start, tip start, and steering wheel-mounted shift controls wrapped in leather for an intuitive driving experience.

This Challenger's interior reflects its performance heritage with Laguna Performance Seats featuring SRT embossing. Heated and ventilated front seats ensure comfort in any season, while a heated steering wheel adds refinement to cold-weather driving. The Uconnect 8.4 NAV system keeps you connected with integrated navigation, SiriusXM satellite radio, and smartphone integration through the 18-speaker Harman/Kardon® premium audio system.

Handling and safety receive equal attention throughout the design. The adaptive suspension system works with four-wheel independent suspension geometry and speed-sensing steering to deliver responsive, controlled performance. A broad range of safety features includes electronic stability control, traction control, anti-whiplash front head restraints, dual front and side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag system. The ParkView rear back-up camera and low tire pressure warning system add practical security during daily driving.

The exterior combines functional design with visual impact. 20-inch SRT Low-Gloss Black forged wheels sit beneath the body, shod with performance-oriented Pirelli tires. High-Intensity Discharge headlights with auto high-beam functionality and rain-sensing wipers handle various driving conditions. Heated power door mirrors and a body-color spoiler complete the aggressive stance.

With 48,250 miles on the odometer, this Hellcat is ready for the next owner who appreciates genuine performance. We invite you to examine this vehicle in person and take it for a test drive to experience its capabilities firsthand.

This 2019 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 1LT delivers authentic sports car performance with a striking red exterior and a commanding presence on the road.

- 6.2L V8 engine with 8-speed automatic and paddle shift capability
- Z51-style 5-split spoke black-painted aluminum wheels (19" front, 20" rear)
- GT bucket seats with 8-way driver and passenger seat adjusters
- Bose Premium 9-speaker audio system with SiriusXM
- Chevrolet Infotainment System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Heated power door mirrors with automatic adjustment
- Rear window defroster and dual-zone automatic climate control
- Exterior parking camera with rear view
- High-intensity discharge headlights with full automation
- Remote vehicle starter system with keyless entry
- Electronic stability and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Painted body-color carbon fiber removable roof panel
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags plus occupant sensing airbag system

The heart of this Corvette lies in its powerful 6.2L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission featuring paddle shift controls for driver engagement. With the ability to shift manually or leave it in automatic modes, you maintain complete control over your driving experience. The responsive steering and four-wheel independent suspension work together to provide the precise handling expected from Chevrolet's iconic sports car.

The interior reflects true sports car design with GT bucket seats offering substantial support and customizable positioning through 8-way adjusters. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob enhance the premium feel, while the sport steering wheel design puts control directly in your hands. Climate control extends throughout the cabin with dual-zone automatic temperature management, ensuring comfort regardless of conditions.

Modern connectivity features make this Corvette as practical as it is capable. The Chevrolet Infotainment System integrates seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected to navigation, music, and communication. The Bose premium audio system with nine speakers delivers quality sound for every drive, supplemented by SiriusXM satellite radio for endless entertainment options.

Safety is comprehensively addressed through dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and occupant sensing technology. Electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and low tire pressure monitoring work together to enhance confidence during every journey. The exterior parking camera provides visibility when reversing, and the emergency communication system adds an extra layer of security.

With just over 10,700 miles on the odometer, this Corvette presents an exceptional opportunity to own a relatively young example of American sports car excellence. The removable body-color carbon fiber roof panel and black-painted aluminum wheels showcase both performance orientation and refined styling. Contact us to schedule a test drive and experience what makes the Corvette Stingray a legendary choice for drivers who demand genuine performance and timeless design.

The 2020 Toyota Supra 3.0 introduces a tech-forward cockpit centered around a vivid infotainment display with Apple CarPlay connectivity, letting drivers integrate music, navigation, and messaging apps seamlessly.

Tech-focused drivers who demand streamlined connectivity and advanced interfaces will find this coupe especially compelling. The Supra's interface supports app mirroring and voice commands, allowing easy access to playlists, calls, and messages without distraction. Features like adaptive cruise control with Stop & Go and a comprehensive Driver Assist Package equip the car for those who value both digital convenience and active safety. Whether commuting or enjoying spirited weekend drives, owners can depend on a blend of luxury materials, digital systems, and contemporary design.

This sports car’s performance is elevated by electronic controls that customize the drive. The 3.0L I6 Twin Scroll Turbo engine, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive, benefits from adaptive suspension and speed-sensing steering. These systems adjust dampers and steering feedback in real-time, giving drivers a tailored feel for every scenario. Electronic stability control and selectable drive modes enable precise responses and smooth transitions, making the Supra as comfortable for daily commutes as it is for spirited backroad exploration.

Smart safety is a core component of the Supra’s technology suite. Blind Spot Monitor and Rear Cross Traffic Alert use radar and ultrasonic sensors to scan traffic, actively warning the driver of unseen vehicles or obstacles. The exterior parking camera delivers clear visuals for reversing, while clearance and backup sonar enhance low-speed maneuvering. Adaptive cruise control uses onboard radar to maintain preset distances, adding peace of mind in stop-and-go traffic. Rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights automate routine adjustments for safer, more convenient driving.

The Driver Assist Package brings advanced digital features to the Supra, including adaptive cruise control with Stop & Go, blind spot monitoring, and rear cross traffic alert. The premium JBL audio system with 12 speakers and integrated navigation make long road trips and daily drives more engaging and connected. Dual-zone automatic climate control, memory seats, and the HomeLink garage door transmitter add practical luxury. Apple CarPlay integration ensures that smartphone apps, navigation, and media are always within reach through the central display and steering wheel controls.

Against direct competitors like the BMW M240i and the Chevrolet Camaro SS, the Supra distinguishes itself with its robust app ecosystem, immersive JBL sound, and a more advanced suite of active driver-assist technologies.

Does this coupe feature wireless Apple CarPlay? Yes, Apple CarPlay integration is included, allowing seamless app use and media streaming. What driver assistance technology comes standard? The car includes adaptive cruise control with Stop & Go, blind spot monitoring, rear cross traffic alert, and a backup camera for comprehensive support.

To experience the fully connected cabin and tech ecosystem of the Supra, contact Bayway Chevrolet at 281-719-9821 or visit 5719 Broadway St, Pearland, TX, 77581. Their team can guide you through the Supra’s digital features and advanced driver assistance technologies, helping you stay connected in an increasingly digital world.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, ABS brakes, and an occupant sensing airbag system work together to protect occupants. Four-wheel independent suspension with an adaptive system provides controlled handling, while four-wheel disc brakes deliver confident stopping power.

Additional conveniences include HomeLink garage door transmitter, automatic temperature control with front dual zone climate zones, heated door mirrors with turn signal indicators, and a security system with panic alarm. - 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- Equipment Group 301A High Package with ambient lighting and MyColor customization
- Mustang Nite Pony Package featuring black mirror caps, black GT pony badges, and black headlamp bezels
- 9-speaker stereo system with SiriusXM w/360L and HD Radio
- Painted black roof coordinating with the Nite Pony aesthetic
- Cloth and vinyl heated bucket seats
- SYNC 4 infotainment with FordPass Connect internet capability
- Rear parking sensors and exterior parking camera
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control

The Mustang GT's 5.0L V8 engine delivers the power Mustang owners expect, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission that handles both spirited driving and daily commuting. The combination achieves 15 city and 24 highway MPG, balancing performance with practicality. Rear-wheel drive ensures the dynamic handling characteristics Mustang drivers demand.

The Nite Pony Package elevates the visual presence with black mirror caps, black pony badges, and dark headlamp bezels that create a cohesive, aggressive appearance. The painted black roof complements the Black exterior, while the interior welcomes you with heated bucket seats designed for driver engagement.

Inside, the SYNC 4 system keeps you connected through FordPass Connect, allowing remote vehicle management through your smartphone. The 9-speaker audio system paired with SiriusXM satellite radio ensures quality entertainment throughout your drive. Ambient lighting with MyColor customization lets you personalize the cabin atmosphere to match your mood.

Safety is addressed through comprehensive features including dual front and side impact airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS. The rear parking sensors and exterior parking camera provide confidence in close-quarters maneuvers. Emergency communication through 911 Assist adds an extra layer of security.

This 2025 Mustang GT combines the straight-line performance and distinctive styling that have made the nameplate an icon, with modern conveniences and safety technology that reflect contemporary expectations. The vehicle is ready for your ownership and stands prepared for both weekend driving enjoyment and everyday reliability.

The C6-generation Chevrolet Corvette Z06 redefined American performance by combining world-class engineering with the raw power of a naturally aspirated big-displacement V8. Drawing inspiration from the legendary C6.R race cars, the 2007 Z06 featured an aluminum chassis, lightweight construction, and track-ready suspension, making it one of the most capable performance cars of its era. Offered here is an exceptional example finished in eye-catching Victory Red over an Ebony leather interior, showing just 16,496 original miles from new. Originally ordered through Feldman Chevrolet in Novi, Michigan, this Corvette has been meticulously preserved and remains a stunning representation of Chevrolet's flagship performance machine.

At the heart of this Z06 is the legendary LS7 7.0L V8, factory rated at an impressive 505 horsepower and 470 lb-ft of torque. Hand-assembled at GM's Performance Build Center, the LS7 features titanium connecting rods, lightweight intake valves, a dry-sump lubrication system, and race-inspired engineering that delivers exhilarating performance with everyday reliability. Power is routed through the highly regarded Tremec T56 six-speed manual transmission, providing an engaging driving experience that perfectly complements the Corvette's razor-sharp handling and explosive acceleration.

The exterior remains beautifully original, with the bold Victory Red finish highlighting the Z06's aggressive styling cues, including its wider fenders, functional brake cooling ducts, lightweight front splitter, and distinctive rear spoiler. As one of only 8,159 Z06 models produced for the 2007 model year, this Corvette represents an increasingly desirable example of one of the most celebrated modern American sports cars. Its remarkably low mileage and careful ownership are evident throughout, making it equally appealing to collectors and enthusiasts alike.

Inside, the Ebony leather interior offers the perfect blend of performance and comfort. Heated seats provide year-round driving enjoyment, while push-button start and the driver-focused cockpit reflect the C6's modern engineering. This Corvette is accompanied by both original keys and the owner's manual, further reinforcing its well-preserved and complete presentation. A clean CARFAX report and non-smoker history add additional confidence to an already impressive package.

Whether destined for weekend cruises, spirited backroad drives, or inclusion in a serious performance car collection, this 2007 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 checks every box. Combining ultra-low original mileage, documented history, exceptional originality, and the unforgettable performance of the hand-built LS7 V8, this is an outstanding opportunity to acquire one of the finest examples of Chevrolet's iconic C6 Z06. As naturally aspirated, manual-transmission performance cars continue to become increasingly scarce, this Corvette stands as a modern classic with enduring appeal.

This 2020 Dodge Challenger R/T Scat Pack combines raw performance capability with refined daily-use features, offering a distinctive driving experience for those who value both power and practicality.

- SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission
- Drag Mode Suspension with Adaptive Damping for responsive handling
- Dodge Alcantara Performance Steering Wheel with heated function
- Harman/Kardon Premium Audio System with 18 speakers and trunk-mounted subwoofer
- Uconnect 4C Navigation with 8.4" touchscreen display
- High-Intensity Discharge Headlamps with fog lights

- SRT Performance Spoiler for aerodynamic styling
- 20" Low Gloss Black Drag Wheels with high-performance tires
- Drag Pak performance features including 1320 Performance Pages
- Power Tilt/Telescope Steering Column with remote start capability
- Heated front seats with ventilation and Nappa/Alcantara trim

- Premium-stitched dash panel with ambient door lighting

The Black exterior presents a commanding presence, while the carefully selected performance upgrades deliver both track-ready capability and street-friendly refinement. The drag-focused suspension setup and performance wheels demonstrate this vehicle's engineering focus, supported by comprehensive electronic management systems that optimize power delivery and handling characteristics.

The 1320 package represents a serious commitment to performance, including drag-specific programming, a transbrake system, and a year of NMCA/NHRA membership for those interested in organized motorsports. The Drag Mode suspension works in concert with the Speed Limited Engine Controller to provide adjustable performance parameters, while the illuminated air catcher and performance badging showcase the vehicle's purposeful design.

Interior appointments reflect a balance between performance emphasis and comfort. The Alcantara performance seats feature premium stitching and heating capability, while the heated steering wheel and ambient lighting create an upscale atmosphere. The Harman/Kardon audio system with surround sound and subwoofer provides an immersive listening experience, and Uconnect Navigation keeps you connected and oriented.

With 64,877 miles on the odometer, this example shows responsible use while delivering substantial driving enjoyment. The combination of draft-specific performance features and daily amenities makes this a well-equipped choice for enthusiasts seeking a versatile performance vehicle.

We invite you to schedule a showing at your earliest convenience to experience this R/T Scat Pack firsthand.

description:
This 2020 BMW 8 Series M850i xDrive represents a sophisticated blend of performance and luxury, offering the discerning driver an exceptional vehicle that commands attention both on the road and in any setting.

- 4.4L V8 32V TwinPower Turbo engine with 8-Speed Automatic Sport transmission
- All-Wheel Drive (xDrive)
- 20" x 8" Front and 20" x 9" Rear M V-Spoke alloy wheels
- Individual Extended Merino Leather Upholstery
- Heated front seats with armrests and heated steering wheel
- Front ventilated seats
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay Compatibility
- Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System with 16 speakers and SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Heads-Up Display
- Wi-Fi Hotspot and Wireless Charging
- Auto-dimming Rear-View mirror with Exterior Parking Camera Rear

The eight-speed automatic transmission with sport tuning ensures smooth gear transitions while maintaining engagement during spirited driving. The all-wheel-drive system enhances stability and traction across varied driving conditions.

Inside, the cabin showcases premium comfort and technology integration. The individual Extended Merino leather upholstery wraps the cabin in sophistication, while the heated and ventilated front seats with heated steering wheel accommodate driver preferences year-round. Memory seating allows personalized adjustments, and the sport steering wheel with mounted audio controls keeps essential functions within reach.

Technology features support seamless connectivity and convenience. The navigation system pairs with Apple CarPlay, the Wi-Fi hotspot enables internet access, and wireless charging keeps devices ready. The heads-up display projects vital information onto the windshield, reducing the need to glance away from the road. The Harman/Kardon surround sound system with SiriusXM satellite radio delivers premium audio throughout the cabin.

Safety and handling capabilities reflect BMW's engineering standards. The adaptive suspension system adjusts to road conditions and driving style, while four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering provide dynamic responsiveness. Electronic stability control, traction control, and an array of airbags work together to protect occupants. The rear parking camera assists with precision when maneuvering.

This M850i xDrive presents a distinguished choice for those seeking a grand tourer that balances performance, luxury, and technology. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it meets your automotive expectations.

This 2020 Dodge Challenger R/T Scat Pack in Silver represents a bold statement on the road with its aggressive styling and commanding presence. Built around the legendary SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic transmission, this muscle car delivers the performance and heritage that define American automotive tradition.

- SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 Engine
- 8-Speed Automatic Transmission with Remote Start and Autostick
- Power Sunroof
- Red Brake Calipers
- Uconnect 4C with 8.4 Touchscreen Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 1-Year Guardian Trial
- Heated Front Seats and Heated Steering Wheel
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- 20 Alloy Wheels with Lo Gloss Granite Crystal Finish

- Sport Steering Wheel
- Front Bucket Seats with Center Armrest
- Four-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS

The cabin combines comfort with functionality, featuring front bucket seats with heating, a heated steering wheel, and dual-zone automatic climate control. The Uconnect 4C system with its 8.4-inch touchscreen keeps you connected through Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and SiriusXM integration, while the 4G LTE Wi-Fi hot spot ensures connectivity on the go. Media Hub connectivity with USB ports and auxiliary input accommodates your entertainment preferences seamlessly.

Performance meets practicality with this vehicles suspension and safety features. The four-wheel independent suspension delivers responsive handling, while the sport-tuned stability and traction control systems keep you confident through any situation. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS stopping power are augmented by electronic brake assist, and a comprehensive airbag system provides occupant protection with dual front, dual front side, and overhead airbags.

The exterior styling captures the Scat Packs aggressive DNA with body-color bumpers, a distinctive grille with bezel, and a rear spoiler that signals intent. The 20-inch alloy wheels finished in Lo Gloss Granite Crystal underscore the performance theme, while red brake calipers visible through the spokes add visual intensity. Automatic headlights with delay-off functionality and integrated fog lights ensure visibility in any condition, complemented by heated power-adjustable door mirrors.

This Challenger R/T Scat Pack offers the driving dynamics and modern amenities that make every journey compelling. With 20,622 miles on the odometer, it represents a well-maintained example ready for its next chapter. The combination of SRT engineering, contemporary conveniences, and striking design creates a vehicle that satisfies both practical and passionate drivers.

Visit our showroom to experience this 2020 Dodge Challenger R/T Scat Pack in person and discover why this model continues to define American muscle car excellence.

- Power front bucket seats with driver and passenger adjustment

The GT Performance Package elevates this Mustang beyond standard specifications. Brembo braking systems, performance-tuned suspension geometry, and a sophisticated electronic stability control system work together to provide confidence through corners and on straightaways. The 19-inch wheel and tire package is specifically engineered with summer-only tires designed to optimize grip on both wet and dry surfaces. The 3.73 limited-slip rear axle ensures responsive acceleration and predictable handling characteristics.

Inside, you'll find driver-focused appointments including the engine-spun aluminum instrument panel, which adds a touch of refinement to the sport-oriented cabin. The gauge pack provides real-time feedback on oil pressure and vacuum, keeping you connected to your engine's performance. Dual front bucket seats offer comfort during extended drives, while the split folding rear seat provides practical versatility when needed. Power adjustments on both driver and passenger seats ensure personalized comfort for all occupants.

The technology integration includes a comprehensive safety suite featuring dual front and side-impact airbags, knee airbags, and an occupant-sensing system. The rear-view camera assists with visibility when backing, while electronic stability control and traction control systems provide security in various driving conditions. Air conditioning, speed-sensitive wipers, and an auto-dimming rear-view mirror contribute to daily usability.

This Mustang GT Premium stands ready to deliver the driving experience you've been seeking. We invite you to schedule a visit and get behind the wheel to appreciate the quality and performance this vehicle represents.

* , 2006 Ford Mustang Shelby GT-H
2-Door Coupe

- One of 500 Produced
- 40th Anniversary of the Hertz GT350H
- Shadow Black with Gold LeMans Racing Stripes
- Dark Charcoal Leather
- 4.6L V8 with 325hp (25hp more than the standard Mustang GT)
- 5 Speed Automatic Transmission
- 3:55 Rear Assembly, X Pipe, Handling and Power Packages by Ford Racing
- Appearance Upgrades by Shelby
- Original Window Sticker and Shelby Build Sheet
- Original Hertz Invoice
- All Original, Unmodified Shelby Hertz Example
- Serial Number 329, Matching Serial Number 2007 Convertible also available
- 7,641 Original Miles


The 2006 Ford Mustang Shelby GT-H is a modern collector icon born from the legendary partnership between Ford, Shelby American, and Hertz. Created to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the original 1966 Shelby GT350-H Rent-A-Racer, the GT-H brought back the unmistakable black-and-gold Hertz Mustang theme for a new generation. Limited to just 500 coupes produced, this example represents a rare opportunity to own one of the most desirable modern Shelby Mustangs, remaining completely original and unmodified with only 7,641 original miles.

Finished in the signature Shadow Black exterior with Gold LeMans racing stripes, this Shelby GT-H pays tribute to the famous Hertz Mustangs of the 1960s while showcasing the aggressive styling of the S197 Mustang platform. Shelby appearance upgrades enhance the car's unique presence, while the Dark Charcoal leather interior provides a comfortable and refined cabin. From its exclusive graphics to its special badging and appointments, every aspect of the GT-H was designed to stand apart from the standard Mustang GT.

Performance upgrades developed by Ford Racing helped transform the GT-H into a more capable driver's car. The 4.6-liter V8 produces 325 horsepower, a 25-horsepower increase over the standard Mustang GT, and is paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission for smooth, effortless performance. Additional enhancements include a Ford Racing 3.55 rear assembly, X-pipe exhaust system, and Ford Racing handling and power packages, giving the Shelby GT-H improved acceleration, sound, and road manners while maintaining its factory-backed reliability.

This example is accompanied by outstanding documentation, including the original window sticker, Shelby build sheet, and original Hertz invoice, providing valuable provenance for collectors. It is serial number 329 and is part of the limited run of 500 coupes built. Adding to its exclusivity, a matching serial number 2007 Shelby GT-H convertible is also available, offering the rare opportunity to acquire a complete coupe and convertible pairing.

The 2006 Ford Mustang Shelby GT-H remains one of the most collectible modern Mustangs, combining Shelby heritage, Hertz history, and Ford Racing performance in a limited-production package. Discover this blend of power and precision in our new Dodge inventory today.===== Cutting-Edge Cabin Technology =====Inside the cabin, the Charger Daytona Scat Pack is a showcase of modern innovation. For those who love to document their drives, the integrated *Drive Experience Recorder* captures high-definition video and performance metrics. To complete the premium cabin experience, the *Sun and Sound Package* envelops passengers in concert-quality audio via a *19-speaker Harman Kardon sound system* under a stunning full glass roof. This 2024 Ford Mustang GT in Gray delivers authentic American performance engineered for drivers who demand genuine capability and distinctive style.

- 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine with 10-speed automatic transmission

The heart of this Mustang GT is its 5.0-liter V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission, offering a balance of responsive acceleration and highway efficiency. The SelectShift transmission with paddle shifters puts gear selection in your hands when you want it, while the 3.15 limited slip rear axle ensures confident handling through corners. Inside, you'll find leather-wrapped controls including the sport steering wheel and shift knob, creating an environment built around the driving experience. The front bucket seats with center armrest provide comfort for both driver and passenger, while the split-folding rear seat adds versatility for cargo needs.

Technology integrates seamlessly through SYNC 4.0 QNX, giving you voice control and smartphone connectivity. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road, and the trip computer along with outside temperature display provide practical information at a glance. The telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preference, while the overhead console stays organized.

Safety features include dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability control works with traction control to maintain grip, while the four-wheel independent suspension with anti-roll bars provides composed handling. Rear parking sensors combined with the exterior parking camera give you visibility when reversing, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS deliver confident stopping power.

This 2024 Ford Mustang GT represents a complete package for drivers seeking legendary performance with modern comfort and capability. We invite you to our showroom to experience it firsthand.

This 2024 BMW 2 Series 230i combines dynamic performance with refined German engineering, delivering a driving experience that rewards both spirited weekend drives and daily commutes with equal capability.

- 2.0L TwinPower Turbo I4 engine with 8-Speed Automatic Sport transmission
- 19" M Double-Spoke wheels with all-season run-flat tires
- M Sport Package with aerodynamic kit and M Sport suspension
- M Sport Brakes with red calipers
- Shadowline Package with extended trim and M Shadowline Lights
- M Steering Wheel and Variable Sport Steering
- Harman/Kardon surround sound system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Premium Package including moonroof and adaptive full LED lights
- Heated steering wheel and heated front seats
- Live Cockpit Pro with widescreen display and navigation

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility

The striking black exterior with black sapphire metallic accents sets an athletic presence on the road. Inside, the cabin welcomes you with Tacora red Vernasca leather upholstery, blending comfort with sportiness. The M Sport suspension and steering work in concert to deliver responsive handling, while the aerodynamic kit enhances both performance and visual appeal. The power-adjustable front seats with memory function ensure every drive feels tailored to your preferences.

Technology integration is seamless with Live Cockpit Pro at the center of the driving experience. Navigation, entertainment, and vehicle controls flow intuitively through the widescreen display, while smartphone integration keeps your digital life connected without distraction. The Harman/Kardon sound system transforms your commute into an immersive audio experience, and SiriusXM satellite radio provides entertainment options that go far beyond traditional AM/FM broadcasts.

Practicality meets luxury throughout this vehicle. The adaptive full LED headlights adjust to driving conditions automatically, while heated front seats and a heated steering wheel add comfort on cooler days. The reversible moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, creating an open, airy atmosphere. Rear air conditioning ensures all passengers remain comfortable, and the split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs.

Safety is comprehensive and layered, featuring a full complement of airbags, electronic stability control, traction management, and a backup camera for parking confidence. BMW Assist eCall provides emergency communication capabilities, while low tire pressure monitoring and brake assist technologies work continuously to protect you and your passengers.

With just 2,422 miles on the odometer, this vehicle remains essentially new, offering the assurance of factory condition backed by BMW's engineering standards. The combination of spirited performance, sophisticated appointments, and modern connectivity makes this 2 Series an intelligent choice for drivers who refuse to compromise on any front. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand and discover why the 2 Series remains the benchmark for compact sport sedan excellence.

Premium features throughout make every drive rewarding. Leather-trimmed bucket seats offer both support and comfort, enhanced by climate control for year-round satisfaction. The heated steering wheel and accent stitching on the center console and floor mats reflect the attention to detail you'll notice everywhere. Memory settings for the driver seat and mirrors mean your perfect driving position is just one button away.

Technology keeps you connected and informed. The B&O Sound System transforms your music into an immersive experience with twelve speakers plus a dedicated subwoofer. SiriusXM with 360L and HD Radio ensure you never run out of options. Built-in navigation with three years of complimentary service, plus the FordPass app integration, puts comprehensive connectivity at your fingertips.

Safety innovations protect you on every journey. Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist+ includes Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, Evasive Steering Assist, and Lane-Keeping Aid. Blind Spot Assist with road edge detection adds another layer of awareness, while exterior parking cameras and rear sensors guide you through tight spaces with confidence.

The Nite Pony Package styling—black mirror caps, black GT badges, and darkened headlamp bezels—gives this White Mustang an aggressive, contemporary presence. The painted black roof provides striking contrast, while the active valve exhaust with quad chrome tailpipes announces your arrival with authentic performance sound.

This 2012 Challenger R/T represents a direct lineage to American performance tradition, offering the manual transmission, naturally aspirated V8 power, and distinctive styling that enthusiasts value. The Bose audio system delivers clear, well-balanced sound through eleven speakers, while the 2GB Music Box hard drive allows you to carry your music collection onboard. Climate control with dual front zones keeps all occupants comfortable, and the power sunroof with sunshade adds an open-air dimension to your drives.

This vehicle comes certified, having undergone a thorough inspection and meeting rigorous quality standards. You can proceed with confidence knowing this G37 Journey has been carefully evaluated and verified to deliver reliable performance and satisfaction.

The exterior presents a sophisticated appearance in black, complemented by bi-xenon HID headlights that provide enhanced visibility and modern styling. Heated power mirrors, body-color bumpers, and alloy wheels complete a cohesive, well-maintained presentation that reflects quality ownership.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, anti-whiplash front head restraints, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control. Brake assist and low tire pressure monitoring add additional layers of protection and awareness.

We invite you to schedule a time to see and drive this 2011 INFINITI G37 Journey. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you experience what this vehicle has to offer firsthand.

description:
This 2011 Ford Mustang GT Premium delivers the performance and style that define the American muscle car legacy. With its potent 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission, this rear-wheel-drive coupe provides the power and control you expect from the GT nameplate.

- HID headlights
- Glass roof
- Shaker 500 AM/FM stereo with in-dash CD/MP3
- SIRIUS satellite radio
- Premier leather bucket seats with color accents
- Hood scoop and pedestal spoiler
- Side scoops and quarter window louvers
- 19" premium painted luster nickel aluminum wheels
- Decklid face panel
- Active anti-theft system with wheel locks
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Remote keyless entry
- 4-wheel disc brakes with electronic stability control

The exterior captures attention with its striking blue paint enhanced by aggressive GT performance styling. The hood scoop, pedestal spoiler, side scoops, and quarter window louvers create a unified aerodynamic appearance that reflects the vehicle's true driving character. The 19" premium painted luster nickel aluminum wheels provide both visual appeal and functional excellence.

Inside, the charcoal black interior with color-accented seats creates a purposeful driving environment. The bright pony aluminum instrument panel and aluminum shift knob add refinement to the cabin. Premier leather bucket seats offer comfort for daily driving, while the glass roof provides an open-air feel without sacrificing the coupe's structural integrity.

Entertainment and connectivity are handled by the Shaker 500 audio system with AM/FM radio, CD, and MP3 capability, complemented by SIRIUS satellite radio for expanded programming options. Eight speakers distribute sound throughout the cabin for an immersive listening experience. Remote keyless entry, automatic headlights with delay-off feature, and cruise control enhance convenience.

Safety and handling receive equal attention with front and rear anti-roll bars, front wheel independent suspension, and electronic stability control working together with traction control and brake assist to provide confidence in various driving conditions. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and occupant-sensing airbags protect occupants in case of collision. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power.

This Mustang GT Premium combines raw performance capability with refined comfort and modern convenience features. With 18 city MPG and 25 highway MPG, the efficiency doesn't compromise the driving experience you're seeking. Interested buyers are invited to schedule a viewing and take this iconic American performance car for a test drive.

Experience the thrill of driving a 2011 Ford Mustang V6 Premium Coupe, a true American muscle car that combines style, power, and modern features. With its sleek Ebony exterior and matching black interior, this used Mustang offers a commanding presence on the road. Equipped with a 3.7-liter V6 engine delivering 305 horsepower at 6,500 rpm and 280 lb-ft of torque at 4,250 rpm, it provides an exhilarating driving experience. The automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive ensure smooth handling and classic Mustang performance. With just under 98,143 miles, this coupe is ready to deliver driving enjoyment with its fuel-efficient gasoline engine and stylish design, making it a perfect choice for enthusiasts seeking a combination of power and comfort.

Whether commuting or cruising, this Mustang combines advanced technology with a stylish interior to ensure every drive is enjoyable.

This Mustang prioritizes safety with dual front active head restraints that help reduce whiplash injuries. It features four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) to improve stopping power and stability under hard braking conditions. Power door locks provide added security, allowing you to secure the vehicle easily. Additionally, the programmable safety key offers customization for driver preferences, adding an extra layer of security and convenience for daily use.

2011 Ford Mustang Entertainment and Technology Features

Entertainment is at the forefront with voice-operated, hands-free phone call integration that keeps you connected without distraction. The premium audio system includes a 500-watt amplifier, two subwoofers, and six total speakers, delivering immersive sound quality. Auxiliary audio inputs via USB and iPod/iPhone enable seamless music playback from your devices, making every trip more enjoyable. These features combine to offer a modern, connected driving experience in this classic muscle car.

2011 Ford Mustang Performance Features

At the heart of this Mustang's performance is a rear limited slip differential, enhancing traction and handling during spirited driving. This feature ensures better power distribution to the rear wheels, especially in challenging driving conditions, allowing for more confident cornering and acceleration. Coupled with its powerful V6 engine and RWD layout, this Mustang provides a true and engaging driving experience suited for enthusiasts who appreciate performance and control.

2025 BMW M8 Gran Coupe Competition Gran Coupe — 4.4L V-8 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, Double VANOS variable valve control, twin turbo, premium unleaded, engine with 617HP, 8-speed automatic. The M8 Competition Gran Coupe pairs brute-force V8 performance with four-door practicality, delivering exhilarating acceleration, composed handling and a refined cabin that makes spirited driving comfortable for daily use.

Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto let you mirror favorite apps and media to the car’s screen without cables, keeping navigation, calls and music within easy reach.

An active pedestrian detection system watches the road ahead and can intervene to help prevent collisions, adding a thoughtful safety layer for city driving.

An integrated mobile hotspot turns the car into a Wi-Fi hub so passengers can stream, browse and stay productive without using phone data.

A rearview camera gives a clear perspective behind the vehicle to simplify reversing and parking maneuvers, reducing stress in tight spots.

A head-up display projects critical info—speed, directions and alerts—onto the windshield so you can keep your eyes on the road while staying informed.

Brake assist detects panic braking and helps apply maximum stopping power when seconds matter, improving safety in sudden-stop situations.

Cruise control with steering-wheel controls lets you set and adjust highway speeds without taking your hands off the wheel, easing long-distance driving.

A power close trunk offers hands-free convenience when loading or unloading—press a button and the hatch closes smoothly and quietly.

Ventilated front seats circulate cool air directly where you need it, helping you settle in faster and stay comfortable on hot days.

The voice-activated navigation system finds routes and responds to spoken commands so you can get directions and reroute without taking your hands off the wheel.

Wireless phone integration provides familiar apps and controls on the vehicle’s display, making connectivity intuitive while you focus on driving.

Combining supercar-grade horsepower, modern safety technology and everyday comforts, the 2025 BMW M8 Competition Gran Coupe is engineered for drivers who want both performance and practicality. Experience its blend of speed, refinement and tech by scheduling a test drive and seeing how it fits your driving life.

Mercedes-Benz of Palm Springs is delighted to showcase this Certified Pre-Owned 2024 Mercedes-Benz S 580 4MATIC® Sedan. Finished in a stunning Obsidian Black Metallic exterior over a luxurious Black Nappa Leather interior, and with just 4,302 miles to its name, this exceptional luxury sedan represents the pinnacle of Mercedes-Benz craftsmanship, innovation, and executive comfort.

The S 580 4MATIC® commands attention with its timeless elegance and refined AMG-inspired styling. Equipped with the AMG Line Package, featuring AMG Body Styling, 19-inch AMG Twin 5-Spoke Wheels, AMG Illuminated Door Sills, and a Body-Color Rear Spoiler, it blends sophisticated luxury with athletic presence. Full LED lighting with Adaptive High Beam Assist, a Panorama Sunroof, Soft-Close Doors, and the MAGIC VISION CONTROL® windshield system further elevate its unmistakable presence.


Step inside and experience a first-class cabin trimmed in sumptuous Black Nappa Leather. The interior surrounds every passenger with advanced luxury through the Warmth & Comfort Package, including heated and ventilated front and rear seats, heated front and rear armrests, a heated steering wheel, and power rear seats with memory. The handcrafted cabin is enhanced by Slate High-Gloss Poplar Wood Trim, Multi-Color Active Ambient Lighting, the immersive Burmester® Surround Sound System, AIR BALANCE, and the latest MBUX Multimedia System with Navigation, Augmented Video, wireless Apple CarPlay®, Android Auto™, and a brilliant 12.3-inch center display.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of this flagship luxury sedan is a refined 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine with EQ Boost 48V mild-hybrid technology, producing an impressive 496 horsepower and 516 lb-ft of torque. Paired with the smooth-shifting 9G-TRONIC® 9-speed automatic transmission and intelligent 4MATIC® all-wheel drive, the S 580 delivers effortless acceleration, exceptional composure, and a remarkably refined driving experience. The renowned AIRMATIC® Air Suspension continuously adapts to road conditions, providing outstanding comfort while maintaining confident handling.

Key Features:

• AMG Line Package: Sport-inspired AMG styling with exclusive body enhancements, AMG wheels, illuminated door sills, and premium interior appointments.

• Warmth & Comfort Package: Heated and ventilated front and rear seats, heated steering wheel, heated armrests, and enhanced comfort amenities for every passenger.

This 2024 Mercedes-Benz S 580 4MATIC® Sedan is far more than simply a luxury automobileit is the flagship expression of Mercedes-Benz innovation, prestige, and engineering excellence. Combining exhilarating V8 performance with world-class comfort and cutting-edge technology, it offers an extraordinary ownership experience for the most discerning driver. Available now at Mercedes-Benz of Palm Springs.

This 2024 Mercedes-Benz S-Class S 580 4MATIC® represents a pinnacle of automotive luxury and performance, now available as a Mercedes-Benz Certified Pre-Owned vehicle. With just 6,512 miles, this sedan delivers the full strength of its 4.0L V8 engine paired with a 9-Speed Automatic transmission and intelligent 4MATIC® all-wheel drive, offering 18 city MPG and 27 highway MPG for balanced efficiency on every drive.

This S-Class is equipped with a remarkable collection of premium features:
- 4.5 Degree Rear Axle Steering
- Night Package with high-gloss black accents and trim elements
- 3D Technology Package featuring 3D Instrument Cluster and MBUX Augmented Reality Head-Up Display
- AMG Line with sport-tuned exterior styling and AMG Floor Mats
- 20" AMG Multispoke wheels painted in high-gloss black with premium tire fitment
- Power Rear Seats with memory function
- Heated Steering Wheel with leather construction
- Rear Memory Seats for personalized comfort
- Burmester® 3D Surround Sound System with 15 speakers
- MBUX Navigation and infotainment with Apple CarPlay®/Android Auto®
- Panoramic power moonroof

- 165+ Point Inspection

The interior presents a sanctuary of refined luxury with Nappa leather upholstery, genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts, and dual-zone automatic climate control with memory settings. Every control surface reflects careful attention to detail, from the telescoping steering wheel with audio controls to the HomeLink garage door transmitter and illuminated entry system.

Safety and technology converge throughout this sedan. Dual front, side, and overhead airbags work alongside advanced stability and traction control systems, four-wheel disc ABS brakes, and the eCall Emergency Communication System. Rain-sensing wipers, auto high-beam headlights, and an exterior parking camera provide practical capability in all conditions.

The S 580 4MATIC® combines responsive handling with composed stability. Speed-sensing power steering, front and rear anti-roll bars, and four-wheel independent suspension deliver a composed drive that responds to both highway cruising and spirited handling. The 9-speed transmission balances seamless acceleration with fuel economy across diverse driving situations.

This low-mileage S-Class represents an opportunity to own a distinguished luxury sedan with manufacturer-backed quality assurance and the confidence that comes with certified pre-owned status. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand at our showroom.
